test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2024: Official Paper (Held On: 11 Jul, 2024 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word.

Advanced
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 1.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Advanced"** means something that is highly developed or complex, especially beyond an initial stage. (उन्नत)

 
 
• **Example:** The student is taking** advanced** courses in mathematics.
 
 
 
• **"Progressive"** refers to favoring or promoting change or innovation, moving forward in stages. (प्रगतिशील)
 
 
• **Example:** The company is known for its **progressive** policies on employee welfare.
 
 
 
• Therefore, the correct answer is:** Progressive.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Foreign** (विदेशी): Relating to or originating from a different country.

 
 
• **Example:** She is learning a foreign language to enhance her career prospects.
 
 
 
• **Elementary** (मूलभूत): Basic or fundamental, not advanced.
 
 
• **Example:** The course covers elementary principles of physics.
 
 
 
• **Discarded** (त्यागा हुआ): Thrown away or no longer useful.
 
 
• **Example:** The old furniture was discarded to make room for new items.
 
 

57:Tc82,

The correct answer is Option 1.</
